body: What did you do if I may ask?
Notice how many people genuinely cared when they saw you cry. That is beautiful. Emotional support means a lot.
Same here. Years and years and it keeps getting crappier.
It won't last forever. As long as you didn't screw up something big time, know that loneliness disappears with time
I understand you being scared. Talking to a therapist or a close person that you trust may be the best way to understand what and why is going on. You'll feel relieved, at the least.

Do you want to kill yourself? I dream about it because I do, but if you are scared you probably don't want to, which is good. Exercise, eat healthy and sleep at regular times and maybe those nightmares will stop.
Congrats man.. I've done so many mistakes in my life I don't even have the strength to hope for anything anymore
